# Brand artwork sources

- Muse: official favicon from https://ai.meta.com/muse/ — https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/rsrc.php/yf/r/-7pQO6hUGK_.svg
- Cursor: official icon from https://cursor.com/brand — https://cursor.com/marketing-static/favicon-light.svg

Artwork is displayed in grayscale to match the requested monochrome theme. Provider catalog previews do not imply a live integration or endorsement.
